page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM, translating to 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.re6p.large resides in the lower performance tiers for most compute and memory operations. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1312.39, while the multi-core score is 1746.48. Memory bandwidth tests show 97.49 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 14.09 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Passmark CPU and memory scores are 2151.57 and 1515.49 respectively. However, single-threaded bzip3 decompression shows average performance at 8.99 GB/sec.

The qualitative cost profile of the ecs.re6p.large reflects a budget-conscious, entry-level resource tier. The primary tradeoff is the low multi-core processing capacity and limited memory bandwidth, which constrains its utility for resource-intensive tasks. Database operations and Redis SET operations are limited, with Redis achieving 1.69 million operations per second. Consequently, this instance is best suited for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, single-threaded file processing, and minor utility tasks that do not require high computational density.
